source_title: GB Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: The annual report states on page 33 that the Strategic Review was approved by the Board on 24 June 2019; an archival copy of the same report is preserved with its hash and extracted text in the source index.
observation: GBG delivered strong growth without a restructuring signal. Revenue rose 20% to £143.5m and adjusted operating profit rose 21.7% to £32.0m, leaving adjusted operating margin broadly stable at 22.3%. Cash generated from operations was £27.8m versus £31.6m, while large strategic acquisitions increased loans to £86.9m and reduced cash to £21.2m. Management nevertheless reported performance ahead of expectations and expected continuing double-digit organic growth.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; acquisition integration, portfolio branding and ordinary operating improvements are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: Acquisition-funded leverage and slightly lower operating cash generation create limited financial pressure, but strong revenue and adjusted-profit growth, stable margin and confident organic-growth expectations provide dominant contrary evidence.

source_title: GB Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2021
availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on page 61 that the balance sheet was approved by the Board on 14 June 2021; the official PDF is preserved with its hash and extracted text in the source index.
observation: GBG described record financial performance despite the pandemic. Revenue increased 9.3% to £217.7m, adjusted operating profit increased 20.8% to £57.9m, adjusted operating margin improved 250bps to 26.6%, profit before tax rose 66.1%, and adjusted EBITDA cash conversion reached 119.5%. Operating cash flow enabled £62.5m of debt repayment, clearing the outstanding loan balance and leaving £21.1m of cash.
already_announced_exclusion: No qualifying restructuring or equivalent intervention had been announced by cutoff; a small acquisition and the disposal of the non-core Employ and Comply business are excluded from the target definition.
review_note: The adverse operating environment did not translate into company-specific intervention pressure: growth, margin expansion, cash conversion and full debt repayment all provide very strong quantified contrary evidence.

source_title: GB Group plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: The issuer-hosted annual report states on page 23 that the Strategic Report was approved by the Board on 14 June 2023; the official PDF is preserved with its hash and extracted text in the source index.
observation: Deep post-pandemic corrections in cryptocurrency and fintech volumes weakened Identity Americas. Adjusted operating margin fell 280bps to 21.5%, a £122.2m non-cash goodwill impairment contributed to a £112.4m statutory operating loss, and £1.8m of exit costs arose from streamlining teams and delivering acquisition synergies; those team exits are excluded because they occurred before cutoff. Revenue still rose 15% to £278.8m, adjusted operating profit rose to £59.8m, net debt improved slightly to £105.9m, and the business remained cash-generative.
already_announced_exclusion: The limited team exits, acquisition-synergy actions, brand consolidation and integration work recorded during FY23 were already undertaken before cutoff and are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Material end-market weakness, a clear margin decline, impairment and completed team streamlining create substantial pressure, while revenue growth, stable adjusted profit, modest debt reduction and continuing cash generation provide meaningful but not dominant offsets.
